svg.title: FreshCart secure CI/CD and Google Cloud deployment architecture
svg.desc: Architecture from pull request checks through Docker build, Trivy scanning, Artifact Registry, Terraform staging deployment, approval-gated production promotion, and rollback.
svg.text: FreshCart Secure CI/CD & Google Cloud Architecture
Pull request validation → immutable image → staging → approval → production → tested rollback
One trusted workflow creates the deployable artifact
Short-lived token; no stored GCP key
Creates templates, MIGs, LBs, IAM and networks
Production job waits here after staging passes
Google Cloud project · isolated production resources
workflow_dispatch selects a previous known-good Artifact Registry SHA → Terraform replaces staging template/MIG → verifies exact image + /healthz + /api/products
